reuse.why: Changes the holiday match inside the existing shared helpers isSkippedDailyOccurrence and isWeekendOrHoliday, which all server callers already use.

duplication.why: Replaces the two separate includes(dayFromDate(date)) checks with one new isHoliday function, removing duplication rather than adding it.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the other holiday/weekend helpers.

scope.why: A small, focused edit of the matching logic plus targeted tests.

maintainability.why: One documented function now defines what counts as a holiday, so future formats change in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks route through isHoliday via the existing shared helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the diff consolidates two copies into isHoliday.
